definitions.explanation: A formal or celebratory gathering with food and drink, often for a group of people.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{宴会|えんかい}で{飲|の}みすぎた。
examples.english: I drank too much at the company party.

examples.japanese: {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}の{宴会|えんかい}{会場|かいじょう}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I reserved a venue for the year-end party.

examples.japanese: {宴会|えんかい}は{盛|も}り{上|あ}がって{夜遅|よるおそ}くまで{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: The party was lively and continued until late at night.

notes:
USAGE: {宴会|えんかい} typically refers to Japanese-style group gatherings with food and alcohol, often held at restaurants or izakaya.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{宴会|えんかい}を{開|ひら}く (to hold a party)
・{宴会|えんかい}{会場|かいじょう} (party venue)
・{宴会|えんかい}{料理|りょうり} (banquet dishes)
・{宴会|えんかい}コース (party course menu)

TYPES OF {宴会|えんかい}:
・{忘年会|ぼうねんかい} (year-end party)
・{新年会|しんねんかい} (new year party)
・{歓迎会|かんげいかい} (welcome party)
・{送別会|そうべつかい} (farewell party)

RELATED:
・パーティー - party (Western-style)
・{飲|の}み{会|かい} - drinking party (more casual)
